title: People's Bank (Amendment)
long_title: AN ACT TO AMEND THE PEOPLE'S BANK ACT NO, 29 OF 1981.

edition.caveat: private republisher, not the Government Printer

body.heading: Capital
body.raw_text: 12. (1) The authorized capital of the bank shall be one thousand million rupees divided into twenty million shares of fifty rupees each. (2) The paid-up capital of the bank shall be such, amount as may be determined from time to time by the Minister by Order published In the Gazette ".

body.heading: Insertion of new section 42A in the principal enactment
body.raw_text: 4. The following new section is hereby inserted. immediately after section 42, and shall have effect as section 42A of the principal enactment:- "Minister of give directions. 42A.The Minister may from time to time give general or special directions in writing to the Board as to the performance of the duties and the exercise of the powers of the bank and it shall be the duty of the Board to comply with such directions,
